title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
The page is a 'formulaire', a reference table of equivalent presentations of the group Grothendieck calls ST_{1,1}. This is the braid group B_3, viewed as the 'special' Teichmüller group of type (1,1): the mapping class group of a torus with one boundary component (or with a tangent vector), a central extension of SL(2,Z). The previous page reduced the main generators to ε0, ε1, σ, ρ and the central element ω. This page lists, for each pair of these generators, a presentation and formulas for the other two.

(1) Generators (ε0, ε1). Relation: the braid relation ε0ε1ε0 = ε1ε0ε1. Definitions: σ = ε0ε1ε0 (the Garside half-twist Δ) and ρ = (ε1ε0)^{-1}.

(2) Generators (ε0, σ). Relations: [σ², ε0] = 1 and (σ^{-1}ε0)³ = σ^{-2}. Formulas: ε1 = σε0σ^{-1} and ρ = σ^{-1}ε0. A symmetric version uses ε1: ε0 = σε1σ^{-1}, ρ = ε1σ^{-1}.

(3) Generators (ε0, ρ). Single relation: ρε0ρ^{-1}ε0ρ = 1. Formulas: ε1 = ρε0ρ^{-1} and σ = ε0ρ^{-1}. Symmetric version: ε0 = ρ^{-1}ε1ρ, σ = ρ^{-1}ε1.

(4) Generators (σ, ρ). Single relation: ρ^{-3} = σ². This is the classical presentation ⟨x, y | x² = y³⟩ of B_3, the trefoil knot group. Formulas: ε0 = σρ and ε1 = ρσ.

The boxed summary collects three facts:
- the braid relation;
- ω := σ² = ρ^{-3} is central (it is Δ²);
- ρε0ρ^{-1}ε0ρ = 1.
It also records the conjugation actions int(σ) and int(ρ): σ swaps ε0 and ε1, ρ sends ε0 to ε1.

The programme at the bottom lists what a fuller table would need:
- a) add ε∞ = ρ²(ε0) and ℓ_i = ε_i² for i ∈ {0, 1, ∞} (presumably the full Dehn twists, if the ε_i are half-twists);
- b) add the reflections τ_i to cover the extended group ST^±_{1,1};
- c) give the natural representations into GL(2,Z) for the quotient by ω² = 1. That quotient B_3/⟨Δ⁴⟩ is SL(2,Z), where σ has order 4 and ρ has order 6, with σ² = ρ^{-3} = -I. The extended group would land in GL(2,Z).

Purpose: this serves Grothendieck's study of the low levels of the Teichmüller tower (the (1,1) and (0,4) building blocks discussed in the Esquisse). It sets up the symmetric, 'triangle'-indexed description of B_3 and SL(2,Z) from the previous page, with ε0, ε1, ε∞ permuted cyclically by int(ρ).
errors: No errors. The relation [σ², ε0] = 1 in presentation (2) is redundant. Setting ρ = σ^{-1}ε0, the second relation reads ρ³ = σ^{-2}, so σ² commutes with ρ and σ and hence with ε0 = σρ. It is harmless, and possibly kept on purpose to stress that σ² is central.
Checked: ε0 = σρ and ε1 = ρσ follow from σ = ε0ε1ε0 and ρ = ε0^{-1}ε1^{-1} together with the braid relation.
Checked: ρε0ρ^{-1} = ε1, and ρε0ρ^{-1}ε0ρ = ε1ε0(ε1ε0)^{-1} = 1.
Checked: presentation (3) is complete. Defining ε1 := ρε0ρ^{-1}, the relation forces ρ = (ε1ε0)^{-1}, and substituting back gives the braid relation.

ideas.what: Braid group B_3 presented as ⟨ε0, ε1 | braid relation⟩ and equivalently as ⟨σ, ρ | σ² = ρ^{-3}⟩, with Garside element σ = Δ and central element Δ² = ω
ideas.modern_name: Standard presentations of B_3 / trefoil knot group; Garside element
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the Teichmüller tower and Γ_{1,1}, but not this specific table

ideas.what: One-relator presentation ⟨ε0, ρ | ρε0ρ^{-1}ε0ρ = 1⟩ of B_3
ideas.modern_name: Alternative one-relator presentation of B_3 (a Tietze transformation of the standard one)

ideas.what: B_3 modulo ω² (i.e. modulo Δ⁴) is SL(2,Z), with natural representations into GL(2,Z) for the extended group ST^±_{1,1}
ideas.modern_name: B_3/Z² ≅ SL(2,Z); extended mapping class group of the once-punctured torus ≅ GL(2,Z)

ideas.what: Symmetric indexing of the generators by {0, 1, ∞}: ε∞ = ρ²(ε0), with int(ρ) giving ternary symmetry and int(σ) giving binary symmetry
ideas.modern_name: S_3-symmetric presentation of B_3 / SL(2,Z) compatible with the cusps 0, 1, ∞ of P¹ minus three points
ideas.usually_credited_to: Implicit in work on the Grothendieck–Teichmüller group (Drinfeld; Ihara; Lochak–Schneps)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a careful but standard table of equivalent presentations of B_3 ≅ ST_{1,1}, and every relation is correct. The only personal touch is the {0, 1, ∞}-symmetric bookkeeping meant for the Teichmüller tower, which later work (Lochak–Schneps, Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps) covers. Nothing here is new.
transcription_corrections: In (3), the second formula is σ = ε0ρ^{-1}; the stray subscript on ρ in the image is a pen correction, not an index.
The header date reads '(5/83)' or possibly '(1983)'; the handwriting is ambiguous.
Bottom item c) reads 'Donner (pour la relation supplémentaire ω² = 1) les représentations naturelles dans GL(2,Z)'; the word 'supplémentaire' is uncertain.
In the summary box, σ(ε1) = ρ^{-1}(ε1) = ε0; the transcribed 'ε_4' is ε1.
